summary: BioHarvest Sciences Inc., a Canadian pharmaceutical firm, filed a Form 6-K reporting its intention to dual-list its ordinary shares on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE). The company has already listed on Nasdaq and plans TASE trading beginning September 8, 2026, registering all 22,667,842 outstanding common shares, future equity incentive shares, and warrants. This is a routine listing announcement without special-situation attributes such as acquisitions, restructuring, or capital returns. The filing is informational, incorporating the press release by reference. What to watch: regulatory approval and start of TASE trading; no risk-arb angle exists as no M&A or corporate action is involved.
